description: This script automates the process of combining SDK zip files, replacing specific components from a base SDK with those from an images SDK, and then optionally zipping the combined contents. It manages temporary directories, unzips the inputs, performs replacements, and produces a bundled output.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a specified directory or file in the unzipped base directory with the corresponding item from the unzipped image directory, with an optional verbose output.
